search.snippet: Bird snares are available from the Hunter supply stores in Yanille and Nardah. They are also found in a box in the bank at Land's End at Zeah. These snares require no bait. They are set in Hunter areas to catch the various birds of RuneScape.

search.snippet: About Bird snare. "A simple bird catcher." Bird snare is the entry-level Hunter trap available from level 1 Hunter. Players lay the snare on a tile to catch crimson swifts, copper longtails, cerulean twitches, golden warblers, and tropical wagtails for Hunter XP, feathers, and bones.
